# T-2: Separate finding identity

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
finding location と root cause を canonical identity に含め、distinct finding が fingerprint と repair status を共有しないようにする。

## Acceptance Criteria
- Findings with a different location have different fingerprints.
- Findings with a different root cause have different fingerprints even when their requirement/guardrail and file match.

## Implementation Notes
findingIdentity() と ReviewFindingFingerprint.fromFinding() の existing canonicalization path を拡張し、text は trim・連続空白を単一空白・小文字化、path は slash を / に統一してから location と root cause を hash input に含める。

## Test Strategy
unit/spec-local tests build otherwise equal findings that differ only by location or root cause.
